question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.

Confusing

The stars twinkled in the dark sky, guiding travellers on their journey.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Confusing"** means causing someone to become bewildered or perplexed. (उलझन भरा)

 
 
• **Example: **The instructions for assembling the furniture were very **confusing.**
 
 
 
• **"Guiding"** refers to showing or indicating the way to someone. (मार्गदर्शन)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher was **guiding** the students through the complex problem.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Confusing'** is **'Guiding'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Twinkled** (टिमटिमाना): To shine with a flickering or sparkling light.

 
 
• **Example:** The stars** twinkled **brightly in the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Travellers** (यात्री): People who are traveling or who often travel.
 
 
• **Example: **The **travellers** were eager to reach their destination.
 
 
 
• **Journey** (यात्रा): An act of traveling from one place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** Their** journey** through the mountains was long and arduous.
